BiblicalUsage: The step is the going of a man's feet, and the Bible watches where they go. Job says my foot hath held His steps, His way have I kept, and not declined; again, if my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes; and the proverb says the simple believeth every word, but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the step is the smallest unit of the Christian life: Job held His steps and did not decline, and the prudent man looks well to his going. The way is walked one step at a time, and I hold that the man who watches his steps is the man who stays on the way.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
